description: Coverage proof mapping task cards to success criteria

SC1.description: At least 5 candidates ranked with price, VRAM, bandwidth, tokens/s, training score

covered_by.coverage: Provides price, VRAM, bandwidth for all 9 hardware items + cloud baseline (10 total, exceeds 5 minimum)
Provides tokens/s for all items at multiple quantization levels
Provides training feasibility scores for all items
Ranks all items using the combined score

SC2.description: Cost-performance formula defined and applied consistently

covered_by.coverage: Defines the formula with weights, normalization methods, and applies it to all comparison set items. Includes scenario-specific weight variants.
Reports the final ranked list and includes the formula in the report for transparency

SC3.description: Scenario-based Top-1 recommendations for S1, S2, S3, S4

covered_by.coverage: Produces explicit Top-1 recommendation for each of the 4 scenarios with justification, alternatives, and availability checks
Includes executive summary with top-line recommendation per scenario

SC4.description: Risk coverage: power, compatibility, used market, new product depreciation

covered_by.coverage: Dedicated risk register covering: used/refurb market risk (mining cards, wear), new product depreciation (50-series launch timing), compatibility risk (drivers, frameworks, PCIe), power/thermal risk, supply chain risk, model evolution risk, eGPU-specific risks
Thermal throttling, sustained workload performance, power supply requirements
Summarizes all risks with mitigation strategies in final report

SC5.description: Mac vs NVIDIA quantified comparison (not just separate analysis)

covered_by.coverage: Dedicated head-to-head comparison with quantified scores (1-10 scale) across 10 dimensions: effective VRAM, memory bandwidth, inference speed, fine-tuning, software ecosystem, total cost, longevity, resale value, and scenario-specific verdicts. Every claim backed by 2+ sources.
Includes Mac vs NVIDIA comparison section in final report
Documents all formula assumptions: weight choices, normalization methods, model size assumptions
Documents benchmark methodology assumptions: model versions, framework versions, quantization methods
Dedicated assumptions section in final report listing all assumptions with confidence levels

SC7.description: All key facts with source URLs, cross-validated by web LLM

covered_by.coverage: Minimum 3 independent retailer sources per GPU, all with URLs
Cross-validation: at least 2 independent sources per benchmark claim
Every claim backed by 2+ sources or direct measurement
Sources from TechPowerUp, Gamers Nexus, Hardware Unboxed, Tom's Hardware with URLs
Complete source bibliography with all URLs in final report
